caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a man standing on a rectangular grayish platform. The man is dressed in a black jacket with gold buttons and a red vest underneath that is buttoned up the center. He wears cream-colored pants with prominent vertical red stripes. On his feet are black shoes. The figure holds a vertically striped red-and-white staff in his right hand. His face shows a prominent mustache and round glasses, and he is wearing a tall black top hat with the word "DAN" written in gold letters on its front. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure and the objects he holds. The composition is centered, and the color palette consists mainly of black, red, cream, white, and gold tones.
title: Dapper Dan Store Figure
